2026_01_WAS_PHI.headline: Washington’s clean injury report gives it a chance to test Philadelphia’s altered defensive edge
2026_01_WAS_PHI.paragraph1: Washington arrives in Philadelphia with no player carrying a final game designation, while the Eagles will be without Jonathan Greenard and list Eli Stowers as questionable. That gives the Commanders a chance to test the edges and make Philadelphia defend extended drives before the Eagles can settle into their preferred pressure patterns. Philadelphia can answer by leaning on physical early-down offense and forcing Washington to tackle repeatedly, turning the opener into a contest over who controls down-and-distance rather than who wins isolated splash plays.
2026_01_WAS_PHI.model_rationale: Washington can probe Philadelphia’s altered defensive front, while the Eagles can counter by controlling early downs and forcing the Commanders to defend long, physical possessions.
